benefits.name: Annual travel credit
benefits.notes: Automatic statement credits on any travel purchase; resets each cardmember year.

benefits.name: The Edit hotel credit
benefits.notes: Two separate up-to-$250 credits per calendar year for prepaid 2+ night stays booked through The Edit by Chase Travel (since 2026 usable any time in the year; was Jan–Jun / Jul–Dec in 2025).

benefits.name: Select hotels credit
benefits.notes: 2026 only: prepaid 2+ night stays booked through Chase Travel at IHG, Montage, Pendry, Omni, Virgin, Minor or Pan Pacific hotels. Stackable with The Edit credit. Not shown on the current Chase page (2026-11-01 check); kept because it ran through 12/31/2026.

benefits.name: Exclusive Tables dining credit
benefits.notes: Up to $150 Jan–Jun and $150 Jul–Dec at Sapphire Reserve Exclusive Tables restaurants on OpenTable. Chase benefit term runs through 6/30/2030.

benefits.name: StubHub credit
benefits.notes: Up to $150 Jan–Jun and $150 Jul–Dec on StubHub / viagogo purchases; activation required.

benefits.name: Peloton membership credit
benefits.notes: Up to $10/month in statement credits toward an eligible Peloton membership; enroll at onepeloton.com.

benefits.name: Lyft credit
benefits.notes: $10 in-app Lyft credit each month; add the card as payment in the Lyft app.

benefits.name: DoorDash $15 promo
benefits.notes: $15 monthly promo on any qualifying DoorDash order (from 10/1/2026; replaced the earlier $5 restaurant promo), while enrolled in DashPass via the card. Part of up to $35/month ($420/yr) with the two $10 non-restaurant promos. Non-cumulative.

benefits.name: DoorDash grocery
benefits.notes: Grocery / retail (non-restaurant) promo, part of the $420/yr DoorDash benefit. Monthly in-app DoorDash promos with DashPass activated through the card: one restaurant promo plus two $10 non-restaurant promos (Chase totals $420/yr). Non-cumulative.

benefits.name: DashPass membership
benefits.notes: Complimentary DashPass when activated with the card (activate by 12/31/2029).

benefits.name: Apple TV
benefits.notes: Complimentary Apple TV subscription; activate by 6/22/2027.

benefits.name: Apple Music
benefits.notes: Complimentary Apple Music subscription; activate by 6/22/2027.

benefits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck
benefits.notes: Up to $120 statement credit for the Global Entry, TSA PreCheck or NEXUS application fee, once every 4 years.

benefits.name: Priority Pass Select
benefits.notes: Priority Pass Select membership (1,300+ lounges, 2 guests). Also includes Chase Sapphire Lounges and select Air Canada Maple Leaf Lounges.

benefits.name: The Shops at Chase credit
benefits.notes: Only after $75,000 spend in a calendar year: $250 credit at The Shops at Chase for the rest of that year and the next.

benefits.name: Southwest Chase Travel credit
benefits.notes: Only after $75,000 spend in a calendar year: $500 credit on Southwest flights booked through Chase Travel, for the rest of that year and the next. Descriptor unverified.

benefits.name: IHG Platinum Elite status
benefits.notes: Complimentary IHG One Rewards Platinum Elite status through 12/31/2027 for the primary cardmember; link your IHG One Rewards account.

benefits.name: Hyatt Explorist ($75K spend)
benefits.notes: World of Hyatt Explorist status after $75,000 in purchases in a calendar year, for the rest of that year, the next calendar year and through February after that; link your World of Hyatt account.

benefits.name: IHG Diamond Elite ($75K spend)
benefits.notes: IHG One Rewards Diamond Elite status after $75,000 in purchases in a calendar year, for the rest of that year and the next calendar year.

benefits.name: Southwest A-List ($75K spend)
benefits.notes: Southwest Rapid Rewards A-List status after $75,000 in purchases in a calendar year; link your Rapid Rewards account.
